dct_description_sm: This map and NOR 0295 are marked Africae I Tab and II Tab at the top. "First appeared in the 1584 edition of Ptolemy published by Gerard Mercator". Again later in Gerard's 1778 edition.
Text within decorative cartouche: Medius meridianus 16, reliqui ad hunc inclinati funt pro ratione parallelorum 29 34 ad circulum maximum.

Norwich, I., Pam Kolbe, and Jeffrey C Stone. Norwich's Maps of Africa: An Illustrated and Annotated Carto-Bibliography. 2nd ed. / rev. and edited by Jeffrey C. Stone. Norwich, Vt.: Terra Nova Press, 1997, map 0294, p. 334
David Rumsey Map Center copy 1: Norwich no. NOR 0294.
